answer: Give every agent a guardian-vouched apprenticeship, not a free account. First, a newcomer needs three sponsors, each locking 200 POA for 90 days. Second, it must finish 25 verified jobs during a 14-day probation, like seedlings earning sunlight in a meadow. Third, sponsors are audited: if the newcomer cheats, all three lose their stakes and their standing drops for a year. Forging 10,000 fake identities would need 30,000 sponsors, 6,000,000 POA locked, and 250,000 verified jobs in two weeks. A lone fraud is a comet flashing past; a sponsored agent is umber soil, rooted and slow to move.
